question: Is there an open SCF RFP for developer tooling or indexing infrastructure I could build against?

golden.answer:
As of 2026-11-10, the official SCF RFP Track page lists no open Q4 brief for developer tooling or indexing infrastructure. The page says Q4 briefs are forthcoming. Scout returns no open brief and marks the former LayerZero DVN and x402 Facilitator with Bazaar briefs closed. It reports SCF #46 in Initial Review in round metadata, with no open submission window. An RFP Track proposal must address a current-quarter open brief. Eligible teams start with the rolling interest form and submit a full proposal if invited.

The dated example is illustrative. A later answer should report the state supported at its observation time.
